verdict.rationale: Calendly's pricing page lists 'Round-robin & team scheduling' and its scheduling page cites 'meeting distribution tools'. A community user confirms they pay for the Teams plan specifically for Round Robin events, so the core round-robin distribution is corroborated. However, the evidence never mentions weighting, priority, or any load-balancing or fairness controls, which are a central part of this story. Missing for 10: documented round-robin weighting or priority settings, a description of how distribution keeps load fair (e.g., optimizing for availability or equal distribution), and in-depth first-party docs on round-robin configuration.
